method.oneToOneMethod: maximum-count ordered matching within a fixed time window; signed delta=candidate-reference
method.nearestDifferenceMethod: bidirectional nearest absolute differences; not a one-to-one match
method.gridRange: 0 inclusive to min(reference.duration,candidate.duration) exclusive; input already time-normalized by probe
limitations: An identical reference tests reproducibility of this input, not musical ground truth.
50 ms matching and 100 ms grids are descriptive measurement choices, not pass/fail criteria.
Boundary nearest-neighbor matches do not establish semantic correspondence of intervals.
100 ms grids can miss shorter mismatches; full source JSON is retained for inspection.
The script uses probe alignment and time normalization; it does not repair input offsets.
No acceptance thresholds or causal attribution are inferred from these metrics.
